metadata.title: Nvidia's stock sinks after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation — live updates - MarketWatch

content.text:
LIVE
Nov. 12, 2026 at 9:57am ET
Nvidia's stock sinks after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation — live updates
Nvidia CEO Jensen has resigned from his role and the stock is falling. Follow along for the latest updates from MarketWatch.
Latest Updates
The worst performer in the S&P 500 isn't Nvidia's stock, despite Jensen Huang's resignation. Rather, it's the shares of one of Nvidia's partners, Super Micro Computer.
While Super Micro hasn't been involved in the recent swirl of controversy surrounding Nvidia's Jensen Huang, it faced a similar scandal earlier this year. Federal prosecutors in Manhattan in March charged Super Micro co-founder Wally Liaw and two others for allegedly illegally diverting advanced Nvidia chips to China.
Super Micro shares were down by more than 8% in recent action on Thursday, according to FactSet data. Nvidia stock was down nearly 7%.
